name: Peutz-Jeghers症候群

summary.text: A genetic intestinal polyposis syndrome characterized by development of characteristic hamartomatous polyps throughout the gastrointestinal (GI) tract, and by mucocutaneous pigmentation. This disorder carries a considerably increased risk of GI and extra-GI malignancies.

symptoms.text: hamartomatous polyps throughout the gastrointestinal (GI) tract
